body: This builts up on glw's PR141 for new thermodynamics and extends the validation using the original *melting_in_spring, * arctic_basin_seasonal_cycle The new section runs the tuned cases, writes comparison summaries and CSVs, and generates plots as part of the normal validation workflow to show that the updated thermodynamics remain consistent with the expected CICE/BL99-style behavior. **arctic_basin_seasonal_cycle ** **melting_in_spring **
title: Extended thermodynamics updated validation
